summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Cashier Loyalty Points Entry System. Backend APIs working perfectly (100% pass rate). Frontend UI and integration working well with one minor redirect issue on phone login.

ui_bugs.issue: Phone login successful but does not redirect to /loyalty portal. Token and customer data are correctly stored in localStorage, but navigate('/loyalty') call is not executing.
ui_bugs.workaround: User can manually navigate to /loyalty after login or refresh page. Login is functional, only redirect is missing.

passed_tests: Backend: Staff login (admin@torado.id)
Backend: Cashier lookup for existing customer (08111222333 → Member 2333 with 15 points)
Backend: Cashier lookup for new customer (returns null correctly)
Backend: Add points for new customer (auto-create Member 7885 with 5 points)
Backend: Add points for existing customer (total 15 points)
Backend: Phone login with correct credentials (returns token)
Backend: Phone login with wrong password (correctly returns 401)
Frontend: Navigation sidebar shows Loyalty section with 'Input Poin Kasir' and 'Voucher Redeem' menu items
Frontend: Cashier loyalty screen loads at /outlet/loyalty/input-poin
Frontend: Phone input and 'Cari' button visible
Frontend: New customer lookup shows 'Akun baru akan dibuat' badge
Frontend: Customer card displays correctly
Frontend: Amount input works (Rp 100,000)
Frontend: Points preview shows +10 poin correctly
Frontend: Add points button works and shows success screen
Frontend: Success screen shows +10 points for new customer
Frontend: Existing customer lookup shows Member 2333 with 15 points
Frontend: Daily Sales form does NOT have customer_phone field (correctly decoupled)
Frontend: Loyalty Portal login page has both Email and Nomor HP tabs
Frontend: Phone login fields visible and functional
Frontend: Phone login stores token and customer data in localStorage
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix phone login redirect issue in /app/frontend/src/pages/loyalty/LoyaltyLogin.jsx. The handlePhoneSubmit function successfully stores token and customer data in localStorage but navigate('/loyalty') is not executing. Check if LoyaltyAuthContext needs to be updated or if there's a routing issue preventing navigation.
